Jia: Quick heads-up: ran seq-aware dispatch probe (small ML heuristic) on h100 pool last night. Seeing p99 regressions for short seqs (<=32) after autotune roll. Putting notes here, cc @Ryan.
Ryan: Can you drop numbers? p50/p95/p99 + sample volumes.
Jia: Summary from microbench (200 reps each) on gpt-small-v1 — seq=16: triton p50=10ms p95=48ms p99=95ms; cutlass p50=9ms p95=28ms p99=54ms. seq=128: triton p99=120ms cutlass p99=150ms (triton wins for long). Raw samples below: 
```text
seq=16 triton: 95.2ms
seq=16 cutlass: 54.1ms
seq=32 triton: 60.8ms
seq=32 cutlass: 34.5ms
seq=128 triton: 120.3ms
seq=128 cutlass: 150.4ms
```
Kevin: Sounds like kernel startup + small-batch inefficiency on the triton path for short sequences. Also noticed KV-cache warmup spike — when KV miss happens the triton path does extra setup. Suggest adding probe cooldown + seq-quantile snapshots and prefer cutlass for seq<=64 until kv_hot. Config proposal: 
```yaml
kernel_router:
  probe_interval_s: 180
  probe_backoff: 2
  prefer_cutoff_seq: 64
  seq_quantiles: [0.5,0.9,0.99]
  kv_affinity_window_s: 120
```
Ryan: Agree. Also need telemetry tags: probe_v2, path=(triton|cutlass), kv_state=(hot|cold), and latency histograms per model+route. Can we get flamegraphs from the microbench?
Jia: Will run flamegraph today and attach. Command I'm using: 
```bash
SCRIPTS/microbench --model=gpt-small-v1 --seqs 16,32,64,128 --engines triton,cutlass --reps 200 --trace flame
```
PerfBot: Job queued: microbench/1421 — expected completion in ~35m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
SRE-Bot: Heads-up: if we change prefer_cutoff_seq we should deploy as a feature flag. Rolling canary to 10% first.
Kevin: Also FYI: autotune recently updated triton kernel selection to prioritize throughput for seq>=64 by default; might be the regression caused by more aggressive kernel creds. Can we pin autotune seed and rerun?
Jia: Good call. I'll add `AUTOTUNE_PIN=20250305` to compare. Will post flamegraphs + compressed traces here when done. :eyes: 
Ryan: :thumbsup: Please add an entry to perf-dashboard under `sequence-aware-routing` with the microbench numbers.
